ideas.pitch: An AI-enabled document parser that converts scattered medical records, prescriptions, and lab reports into a structured, searchable timeline for patients and physicians.
ideas.title: MedVault AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Track 1 with a functioning end-to-end processing pipeline that judges can test live with their own sample PDF uploads.

ideas.pitch: A proactive patient tracking system that monitors missed follow-up visits and overdue diagnostic tests, automatically alerting both patients and care coordinators.
ideas.title: CareContinuum
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves Track 2's specific adherence problem by combining automated SMS/WhatsApp triggers with a clear clinical dashboard that highlights at-risk patients.

ideas.pitch: A data-driven risk stratification engine that generates personalized preventive health screening roadmaps based on user lifestyle data, age, and regional disease prevalence.
ideas.title: VitaRisk AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with Track 3 by demonstrating clear preventive health impact with quantifiable risk scores and actionable wellness recommendations.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage and monitoring assistant featuring rPPG heart rate sensing via smartphone camera and multi-lingual voice support for post-hospitalisation check-ins.
ideas.title: MediScan Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of hard engineering and live camera-based biometrics seen in the hackathon examples.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise-grade document and data interoperability middleware designed in collaboration with AssistHealth to unify disparate health data silos into standard HL7 FHIR formats.
ideas.title: AssistHealth Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages AssistHealth's mentorship and industry challenges by solving a real-world integration bottleneck faced by their platform.
